alt: Anterior view of the chest and shoulder with pectoralis major and deltoid cut away, labelling: pectoralis major (cut), deltoid (cut), coracoid process of the scapula, subscapularis, teres major and serratus anterior.
caption: Muscles that move the humerus, anterior view with pectoralis major and deltoid cut (OpenStax). Labelled here: subscapularis (the medial rotator of the rotator cuff), teres major and serratus anterior, plus the coracoid process.
